Neha — thanks for the packet. Initial read: revenue opportunity is solid, but the subsidiary jurisdiction triggers a medium sanctions risk. Two parallel asks: pricing and eligibility.

Pricing: standard playbook gives up to 25% for AE-led concessions. Anything above goes to Sales Manager + Executive approval. Recommend proposing 30% as a compromise for year one with a structured ramp to net-new pricing year two.

Eligibility/Controls: Compliance will need to do an enhanced screening (Vivek), and if mitigations are acceptable we can do an exception with conditions:
  - Strict IP allowlist: limit model access to specific subdomains/ips
  - Data residency guarantee for Sundial's primary entities (APAC region)
  - Contract clause banning admin/billing for the flagged subsidiary and right-to-audit logs quarterly

This needs Exec sign-off. Can you escalate to Stephanie for final approval on the concession and the conditional export-control exception? If approved, we will require the customer to sign the special terms and pass a sancs screening report.

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk

Subject: RE: Fwd: Sizing & terms question for Redwood - Sundial (DW-2027-0997)

Confirmed — I ran the initial sanctions screen on the subsidiary from the attached report. Flags present but not an automatic prohibition. Recommended mitigations before granting exception:

1) Technical controls
   - Geo-blocking the flagged subsidiary IP ranges; enforce MFA and IP restrictions on any accounts that could access models.
   - Feature gating: no model fine-tuning or export of model weights; limit export/download functionality.

2) Contractual controls
   - Add an Export Controls & Sanctions Addendum: explicit prohibition on transfer to the flagged juris, indemnity clause, right to terminate on change in sanctions status.
   - Quarterly audit log deliverable and Redwood's right to perform a compliance review.

3) Commercial guardrails
   - Approve only if customer signs LOI + special terms, and sanctions reprot clears within 72 hours of signature.

If Deal Desk + Exec want to proceed, I can draft the addendum and run a deeper KYC. My recommendation: conditional approval only; I would support a 30% first-year concession under these controls. Anything >30% materially increases residual risk.

—Vivek
Head of Trust & Safety (Compliance)
Redwood Inference
